head: Interteno is a new Plex player for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch
dek: Interteno is an app for your own Plex media server that combines Plex video and Plexamp-style music, with an Apple Watch app, CarPlay and widgets. It was #90 among paid Entertainment apps on the US App Store on 5 November.
details: It also plays films and TV from tofa. It costs $2.99 with in-app purchases, by David Bryce.
where: iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch, App Store, $2.99
means: If you run a Plex server, it puts movies and music in one native app.
todo: Find Interteno in the App Store; you need your own Plex server.
